# Nydam Photography

> Austin and Texas Hill Country photography studio, est. 2008, run by Arlen and Tanya Nydam. Wedding and event photography and videography, portraits, sports, quinceañeras, and Catholic photography. Editorial portraiture combined with documentary storytelling. Rated 5.0 stars across 18 Google reviews (last confirmed November 11, 2026). Phone: 512-955-4520. Website: https://nydamphoto.com

## Weddings

- [Wedding Photography](https://nydamphoto.com/weddings/): Wedding collections in Austin and the Texas Hill Country. Essential $2,500 + tax (up to 4 hours), Signature $5,000 + tax (6-8 hours), Wedding Story $6,500 + tax (10+ hours across the wedding weekend). A complimentary engagement or bridal session is included with Signature and Wedding Story, and available to add to Essential. Essential includes one photographer; Signature and Wedding Story offer a choice of two photographers or a photographer and videographer. 30% retainer. Sneak peeks within 24-48 hours, full gallery within 21 days.
- [Wedding Collections](https://nydamphoto.com/weddings/collections/): Full details of the three wedding collections, add-ons (second photographer, videography, content creator, albums), and real wedding stories.
- [Wedding Portfolio](https://nydamphoto.com/weddings/portfolio/): A portfolio of 105 real wedding photographs from Austin and Texas Hill Country weddings, grouped by moment of the day — getting ready, ceremony, portraits, reception.
- [Our Wedding Approach](https://nydamphoto.com/weddings/our-approach/): Editorial portraits with photojournalistic storytelling. Candid during the ceremony and reception, calm direction for portraits and formals.
- [Engagement Sessions](https://nydamphoto.com/engagements/): Engagement sessions in Austin and the Hill Country. Available as the complimentary session option (engagement or bridal) with Signature and Wedding Story collections.

## Seniors

- [Senior Portraits](https://nydamphoto.com/seniors/): Senior portraits for the Class of 2027 in Austin and the Texas Hill Country. Built around the senior's interests: sports, dance, cars, farms, city portraits.
- [Senior Collections](https://nydamphoto.com/seniors/collections/): Post $500 + tax (20 images), Frame $850 + tax (50 images, most chosen), Cover Story $1,195 + tax (60 images, hair and makeup included). Proofs in 5 business days, finals 7 business days after selection. Extra images $35, rush 72h $125, cap and gown mini $125.
- [The Senior Year Story](https://nydamphoto.com/senior-team/): Year-long senior experience, $1,650 + tax. Three documentary chapters (fall, winter, spring) plus a Cover Story portrait session and a personalized printed magazine.

## Little Expressions

- [Little Expressions](https://nydamphoto.com/little-expressions/): Five-expression children's portraits in Hutto, Texas (124 Blanco Drive). For children ages 3-10, with individual and sibling portraits. Each appointment allows 25 minutes, including approximately 15 minutes of photography. Mini $175 + tax (3 files + collage), Signature $249 + tax (5 expression files + digital collage), All Expressions $349 + tax (all 8-10 files + collage + $50 print credit). Sibling-only portraits are available as one collection; individual and sibling portraits together require a collection per child, with joint portraits included. New appointment dates are released monthly. Gift certificates never expire, available as digital or printed versions.

## Catholic Photography

- [Catholic Photography](https://nydamphoto.com/catholic/): Catholic wedding and sacrament photography in Austin and the Texas Hill Country, including Nuptial Mass coverage.

## Families, Events, and Corporate

- [Family Portraits](https://nydamphoto.com/families/): Family portraits in Austin and the Texas Hill Country.
- [Family Portfolio](https://nydamphoto.com/families/portfolio/): Selected family portraits.
- [Event Photography & Videography](https://nydamphoto.com/events/): Corporate and private event photography and videography in Austin and Central Texas. Photography can be booked through the event booking page; video and combined coverage are available by inquiry.
- [Book Event Photography](https://nydamphoto.com/events/book/): Book event coverage: Short Event, Half-Day, Full-Day. Videography available on request.
- [Corporate Photography](https://nydamphoto.com/corporate/): Professional headshots (one-hour sessions), team portraits, and brand photography. Delivery within five business days.

- [Event Portfolio](https://nydamphoto.com/events/portfolio/): Selected event photography.
- [Corporate Portfolio](https://nydamphoto.com/corporate/portfolio/): Headshots, team portraits, and branding photography.

## Stories, Guides, and Reviews

- [Wedding Stories](https://nydamphoto.com/portfolio/stories/weddings/): Individual real wedding stories featuring venues, couples, and wedding-day photography.
- [GuideHub](https://nydamphoto.com/guides/): Free planning guides for weddings, seniors, sports, and photo sessions.
